stepAction: Install the app for your platform:|Mac with Homebrew: brew install --cask happenings-community/requests-and-offers/requests-and-offers|Mac DMG: open the .dmg, drag the app into Applications, then run once in Terminal: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Requests and Offers.app"|Windows: run the setup .exe and follow the wizard|Linux: install the .deb, or make the AppImage executable (chmod +x) and run it|If you installed alpha.1 before 25 September, follow the clear-out steps in the release notes first.|In your result, say which platform you used: Mac Apple Silicon, Mac Intel, Windows, Linux .deb or Linux AppImage.
lookFor: The app installs without errors.

stepAction: Look for the connection status dot in the navigation bar and wait for it to settle.|Click it to open the network details. Keep the Network Seed and DNA for step 20.1.
lookFor: The popup shows a Network Seed, a DNA, a Bootstrap Server and a Signal Server.|No line in the popup is marked as a mismatch.

stepAction: In the profile form, fill in Given name, Family name and Nickname. Choose a Type (Advocate or Creator).|Then clear Given name, type only spaces in it, and try to save.
lookFor: Given name, Family name and Nickname are separate fields, all required.|Saving with only spaces in Given name is refused with a message.

stepAction: Fill in Email, Phone, Location and Time zone.|For Time zone, type 'Lond' and choose a result.
lookFor: A notice near Email says your email and phone are visible to all members of the network.|The time zone list closes once you choose a result, and shows your choice.|Every field accepts your input.

stepAction: Fill in the organisation form: Name, Full Legal Name, Email, Vision/Mission and Location (all required).|In URLs, enter two web addresses separated by a comma.
lookFor: All required fields accept input.|After saving (9.4), both URLs appear on the organisation page.

stepAction: One tester must be an administrator.|Tester B: on a fresh install with no profile, create a profile and save it.
lookFor: Tester B's profile status shows as pending approval.

stepAction: Tester B (still pending): open any request that is not yours.
lookFor: A notice says your account is pending approval before you can respond.|You cannot register interest: the Interested button is absent, or using it is refused.

stepAction: Tester B (still pending): try to create a request.
lookFor: Creating a request is refused until you are approved, with a message saying why.

stepAction: Administrator: open the admin panel (Admin in the navigation bar, or Alt+A). On the Admin Dashboard, under Moderation Queue, open Pending Users and click Approve for Tester B.
lookFor: Tester B appears under Pending Users.|After Approve, Tester B is no longer in the list.

stepAction: Tester B: open a request that is not yours.
lookFor: The pending notice has gone.|You can register interest.

stepAction: Administrator: if a third test profile is available, click Reject for it instead. That tester then opens a request that is not theirs.
lookFor: The rejected tester sees their status as rejected.|The rejected tester can take no action in the app: no listings, no interest and no proposals.

stepAction: Edit your profile and set Family name to a single dot ( . ). Save. Look at your name in the navigation bar, All Users and one of your listings.
lookFor: The dot is not shown anywhere your name appears.

stepAction: Edit your profile and use names with accents or other scripts, for example: Zoë, José, 山田, Анна, محمد. Save, then look at your name in All Users and on one of your listings.
lookFor: Every character displays correctly.|Right-to-left text displays the right way round.

stepAction: Edit your profile with a Given name of 60 or more characters and a long Nickname. Save, then look at the navigation bar, All Users and a listing card.
lookFor: Either the form refuses the length with a message, or the long name displays without overflowing or overlapping anything.

stepAction: Two testers online at the same time: Tester A and Tester B.|Tester A: open Tester B's profile.
lookFor: Tester B's email and phone are shown, as the profile form said they would be.|Nothing else private is shown.

stepAction: Create a request. In Links, type https://example.org and press Return.|Type https://example.net and do NOT press Return. Click save.
lookFor: Pressing Return adds the first link as a tag and does not submit the form.|Saving with the second link still typed is refused, with a message that a link has been typed but not added.

stepAction: Press Return on the second link, then save the request.
lookFor: Both links appear under Related Links on the request page.

stepAction: In a new request's Description, paste more than 1,000 characters.
lookFor: The counter shows characters used out of 1000.|Text beyond 1,000 characters is not saved: it is either blocked as you type or refused on save with a message.

stepAction: In the Description, use the formatting buttons above the field, then switch to Preview and back.
lookFor: Each button inserts its formatting.|Preview shows the formatted text.|Switching back keeps everything you typed, and the form does not jump when you click a button.

stepAction: Set Time Estimate in Hours to each of these in turn and save: 1, 0.5, 2.5, 0, -1.
lookFor: 1, 0.5, 2.5 and 0 all save, and show on the request page with correct singular or plural (1 hour, 2.5 hours).|-1 is refused with a message.

stepAction: Create a request titled: Help with garden 🌱, Gartenhilfe, 庭の手伝い. Then search Requests for Gartenhilfe.
lookFor: The title displays correctly on the request page and in the list.|Searching for Gartenhilfe finds the request.

stepAction: With no active offers of your own, create a request and choose Service Exchange as the medium of exchange.
lookFor: A message says you need to publish an offer first.

stepAction: Two testers online at the same time: Tester A and Tester B.|Tester A: create a request.|Tester B: open it and click 'Interested in this request?'
lookFor: Tester B sees that interest is registered, with the date.|Tester B sees Send a proposal, Withdraw interest and View contact information.

stepAction: Tester A: open the same request.
lookFor: Tester B's name appears under Interested members, with a Send a proposal link.

stepAction: Tester B: click Send a proposal. Choose the medium of exchange, enter hours, write the proposal (up to 300 characters) and a delivery timeframe. Click Preview, then Send proposal.
lookFor: The preview matches what you entered.|After sending, the exchange shows as proposed and waiting on Tester A.

stepAction: Tester A: open My Exchanges.
lookFor: The proposal is listed and marked Your turn.|The Side, From, Turn and Order filters show and hide it correctly.

stepAction: Tester A: open the proposal, click Counter, change the hours and send.|Tester B: open the counter-proposal and click Accept and form agreement.
lookFor: Both testers see the exchange as agreed.|The agreed terms are the counter-proposal's, not the original's.

stepAction: Tester B clicks Mark my part done first. Then Tester A clicks Mark my part done.
lookFor: After Tester B's click, the exchange shows it is waiting on Tester A.|After both, the exchange is Complete and each tester sees a review form.

stepAction: Both testers: choose a rating from 1 to 5, set Delivered on time and Matched what we agreed, write a comment and click Submit review.
lookFor: Submit review is unavailable until a rating is chosen.|After both reviews, the exchange shows as reviewed by both, and both reviews are visible to both testers.

stepAction: Two testers online at the same time: Tester A and Tester B.|Start a new exchange and get it agreed. Then either tester opens Cancel this agreement, adds a note and clicks Cancel agreement.
lookFor: Both testers see the exchange as cancelled, with the date.

stepAction: Tester B: send a new proposal, then withdraw it before Tester A responds.
lookFor: Tester B sees the proposal withdrawn.|Tester A sees it as withdrawn and cannot accept it.

stepAction: Tester B: on a request where you have only registered interest, click Withdraw interest.
lookFor: Tester B is no longer under Interested members for Tester A.

stepAction: Tester B: send a proposal with Service Exchange as the medium, and choose 'None of these, get in touch' under Chosen service offer.
lookFor: The proposal cannot be sent.|Your draft is kept.|A way to contact Tester A is offered.

stepAction: Get a new exchange agreed. Both testers click Mark my part done at the same moment.
lookFor: The exchange becomes Complete for both testers, with no error and no duplicate entries.

stepAction: With an agreed exchange, Tester B quits the app. Tester A clicks Mark my part done. After two minutes, Tester B reopens the app and opens the exchange.
lookFor: Tester B sees Tester A's part marked done.

stepAction: Tester A: create an organisation, then open its Requests tab.
lookFor: The page says the organisation must be accepted before it can create requests.

stepAction: One tester must be an administrator.|Administrator: in the admin panel, under Moderation Queue, open Pending Orgs and click Approve for Tester A's organisation.
lookFor: The organisation leaves the pending list.|Tester A can now create requests and offers from the organisation page.

stepAction: Two testers online at the same time: Tester A and Tester B.|Tester A: on the organisation page, open Members, click Add Member and add Tester B.
lookFor: Tester B is listed as a member.|Tester A is listed as a coordinator.

stepAction: Tester B (a member, not a coordinator): create a request, choose the organisation under Organization and save.
lookFor: The organisation is available to choose.|The saved request shows the organisation.

stepAction: Tester A: edit a request that was posted for the organisation.
lookFor: The organisation cannot be changed after publishing.

stepAction: Tester B: on the organisation page, click Leave Organization.
lookFor: Tester B is no longer listed as a member, for both testers.|Tester B's existing listings and exchanges are unchanged.

stepAction: One tester must be an administrator.|Administrator: press Alt+A, then press it again.|A tester who is not an administrator: press Alt+A.
lookFor: For the administrator, Alt+A moves into the admin panel and back.|For the non-administrator, nothing happens.

stepAction: Administrator: in the admin panel, open Users and suspend a test member, giving a reason. That member then tries to create a request.
lookFor: The suspension is saved, and Users Status History shows it with the reason.|The suspended member cannot create a request.

stepAction: Administrator: restore the member to accepted. The member then creates a request.
lookFor: The member can create the request.|Users Status History shows both changes, in order.

stepAction: Administrator: open Administrators and add another tester as an administrator. That tester then presses Alt+A.
lookFor: The new administrator can open the admin panel.

stepAction: Two testers online at the same time: Tester A and Tester B.|Both testers: open the connection status popup and compare your Network Seed and DNA.
lookFor: Both testers have the same Network Seed and the same DNA.

stepAction: Be the only tester online. Launch the app and wait five minutes.
lookFor: The status does not show as fully connected while you have no peers.

stepAction: Quit the app completely and reopen it.
lookFor: Your profile, listings and exchanges are all still there.

stepAction: Only if you have an install from before 25 September: install the new version over it without clearing the old data. Compare seed and DNA with a tester on a clean install (as in 20.1).
lookFor: Your seed and DNA differ from the clean install, as the release notes predict.

stepAction: Intel Mac, Windows or Linux only: install and launch the app, then complete 1.4 and 20.1.
lookFor: The app starts, connects, and matches your partner's seed and DNA.
